title: Circle Theorems
summary: Chords, arcs and angles: the angle at the centre, angles in the same segment, cyclic quadrilaterals and the angle in a semicircle.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026): I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round

objectives: I can apply the angle at the centre and same segment theorems.
I can use the cyclic quadrilateral theorem.
misconceptions: The angle at the centre is half the angle at the circumference.
Any quadrilateral in a circle has opposite angles equal.
The perpendicular from the centre meets any chord at its end.
